use_of_test_split: FOURTH use of the OpenOOD v1.5 ImageNet-1K test split (1st: CLAVIS, 2nd: CLAVIS-M c1, 3rd: CLAVIS-M2). Run exactly once. Final loop.
run_condition: only if the frozen candidate passes the pre-registered rule on dev1 and on its first dev2 look (iter3/dev2_looks.jsonl)
benchmark: OpenOOD v1.5 ImageNet-1K: ID test_imagenet (45,000); near = SSB-hard, NINCO; far = iNaturalist, Textures, OpenImage-O
tins: test_runs/default/<dataset>_seed<s>.npz, stream orders s = 123..127 (same runs as the paper and the third use)
method: CLAVIS-M3 as frozen (prototype views B/14 and L/14, iterated two-stage entrance 0.40 / 0.30 / 0.10, conformal label propagation k = 10, alpha = 0.9, gamma = 3, 15 iterations); memories and graphs reset for every ID+OOD stream
primary_endpoints: near-average and far-average AUROC (upstream get_measures), mean over the 5 stream orders, compared with CLAVIS-M2 recomputed on the same runs (third use: near 92.94, far 98.48)
secondary: per-dataset AUROC / FPR95 and SD over orders
class-level bootstrap 95% interval (B = 1000, seed 123) of CLAVIS-M3 minus CLAVIS-M2 and minus TINS
not_evaluated: no other variant, threshold or backbone is evaluated on the test
